description: 2D complex single-precision FFT benchmark using cuFFT (NVIDIA) or hipFFT (AMD). Performs forward complex-to-complex FFT on an NX×NY grid. Reports effective GB/s based on input+output data movement.

scaling_param.name: grid_dim
scaling_param.description: Square grid dimension NX=NY for the 2D FFT; should be a power of 2 for optimal performance

non_scaling_params.name: warmup
non_scaling_params.description: Number of warmup FFT executions before timing
